Container.Name: Voicebox
Container.Overview:
Voicebox turns plain EPUB books into audiobooks in EPUB 3 Media Overlays format using Azure or Kokoro text-to-speech.
Use the web UI to convert a single book, or drop .epub files into the ingest folder and Voicebox converts them automatically, one at a time. Defaults for automatic conversions are set in the Settings tab and stored in the config folder.
Successfully converted source files are moved to ingest/processed; failures are moved to ingest/failed.
GPU: Extra Parameters is preset to "--runtime=nvidia --gpus all" for NVIDIA acceleration, which needs the Unraid Nvidia Driver plugin. NO NVIDIA GPU? CLEAR THE EXTRA PARAMETERS FIELD, or the container will not start ("Unknown runtime specified nvidia"). With a GPU, also set NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES below and lower Max Workers to 1 or 2 in the web UI, since workers share the one GPU.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the Voicebox web interface.

Config.Name: Ingest Folder
Config.Description: Drop .epub files here to have them converted automatically. Voicebox creates processed/ and failed/ subfolders inside it.

Config.Name: Output Folder
Config.Description: Where the generated audiobooks are written.

Config.Name: Config Folder
Config.Description: Stores settings.json (the automation defaults), and unless you map them separately below, also logs/, huggingface/ (the Kokoro model) and cache/. Keep this on appdata so everything survives container updates.

Config.Name: Logs Folder
Config.Description: Optional. Map a folder here to keep logs outside the config folder. Leave it unmapped and logs go to config/logs.

Config.Name: Models Folder
Config.Description: Optional. Map a folder here to keep the downloaded Kokoro model outside the config folder. Leave it unmapped and the model goes to config/huggingface.

Config.Name: Cache Folder
Config.Description: Optional. Map a folder here to keep the cache outside the config folder. Leave it unmapped and the cache goes to config/cache.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that owns the generated files. 99 is Unraid's nobody.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that owns the generated files. 100 is Unraid's users group.

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: File mode mask applied to generated files.

Config.Name: NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
Config.Description: GPU to use, as reported by 'nvidia-smi -L' (e.g. GPU-1a2b3c4d-...). Only needed when running on an NVIDIA GPU. Leave blank for CPU.

Config.Name: NVIDIA_DRIVER_CAPABILITIES
Config.Description: Driver features exposed to the container. compute,utility is what the TTS model needs. Only relevant when running on an NVIDIA GPU.

Config.Name: AZURE_TTS_KEY
Config.Description: Azure Speech key. Only needed for the Azure TTS engine - the Kokoro engine runs offline with no credentials.

Config.Name: AZURE_TTS_REGION
Config.Description: Azure Speech region, e.g. eastus. Only needed for the Azure TTS engine.
